description: I am Nicolás Martínez, an AI developer, architect, and orchestrator, with a passion for space and science.
summary:
We developed DeepTrau SpaMedic, a Local-First, bilingual (EN/ES) autonomous medical monitoring and clinical triage web application for long-duration human spaceflight. Built around NASA Human Research Program’s 5 Spaceflight Hazards and Canadian Space Agency (CSA) radiation dosimetry concepts, it dynamically adapts risk limits, daily routines, and countermeasures across four mission environments: Deep Space Transit, Planetary/Lunar Habitat, Orbiting Space Station, and Pressurized Surface Rover.

DeepTrau addresses the challenge by turning physiological, metabolic, and behavioral data into a color-coded (Green/Amber/Red) interactive SVG body map with plain-language guidance for non-physician astronauts, cross-checked against pre-flight clinical history (allergies, prior surgeries, low immune defenses, and baselines). It integrates multimodal inputs—a 6-sensor Hub with automatic manual clinical fallback when hardware fails, interactive time-series charts (mSv radiation, mg/dL glucose, leukocytes, bone/muscle retention), Psychomotor Vigilance Testing (PVT), Video-Diary, circadian regulation, and an SOS Emergency Console featuring 6 space-adapted protocols and Earth downlink packaging.

This matters because up to 40-minute round-trip deep-space communication delays make live Earth telemedicine impossible in crises, while delivering offline, zero-paid-license medical autonomy equally vital for remote clinics on Earth.
details:
1. WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

DeepTrau SpaMedic is a Local-First, bilingual (EN/ES) autonomous medical monitoring, preventive care, and emergency clinical triage web platform built around the 5 Hazards of Human Spaceflight (NASA Human Research Program) and operational radiation dosimetry concepts inspired by the Canadian Space Agency (CSA).

The application operates as a four-stage clinical cockpit stored locally in the browser (no login barriers or external database required):

• Step 1 — Mission-Adaptive Calibration (4 Space Environments): Users select Deep Space Transit Spacecraft (0g microgravity, 12–20 min one-way Earth delay, extreme radiation), Planetary or Lunar Habitat (0.16g Lunar / 0.38g Martian gravity, EVA regolith dust risks), Orbiting Space Station (0g, 16 orbital sunrises/day, strict 2-hour daily bone loading), or Pressurized Surface Rover (mobile tactical life support without heavy exercise gear). Mission rules automatically adjust daily radiation rates (mSv/day), dose limits, available hardware, and signal latency.

• Step 2 — Pre-Flight Clinical History (EHR) Cross-Check: Profiles (such as Cmdr. Elena Vance, Dr. Mateo Silva, Eng. Sofía Chen-Ramírez, or custom crew edits) supply blood type (e.g., O-), allergies (e.g., Penicillin, synthetic latex), immune vulnerabilities (Low Defenses / leukopenia tendency), prior surgeries (right knee meniscus, left shoulder rotator cuff), and terrestrial baseline vitals (glucose mg/dL, BP mmHg, resting HR bpm).

• Step 3 — Command Center & Interactive SVG Body Map: Five physiological systems (Brain & Mind, Heart & O2, Blood & Defenses, Glucose & Energy, Bones & Muscle) plus anatomical surgical pins are dynamically color-coded in Green (Optimal), Amber (Caution), or Red (Critical). Selecting any organ displays plain-language answers to: What was detected? Why does it matter in this environment? and What action to take right now? An integrated Shift Risk Briefing, prioritized overdue/urgent daily routine checklist, and gamified adherence counters (Active Streak, Health Points, Readiness %) keep crew compliance high.

• Step 4 — Specialized Operational Workspaces:

- Connect Tools (Sensor Hub): Manages 6 biomedical instruments (Vitals Monitor, CSA Radiation Dosimeter, Glucometer, Hematology Analyzer, Portable SANS/ADUM Ultrasound Scanner, EVA Spirometer) with 4-step measurement guides, equipment self-diagnostics, and ultrasound image upload. Crucially, disconnecting any sensor automatically switches corresponding routine tasks into manual clinical physical exams (e.g., Amsler visual grid, radial pulse, tape muscle girth).

- Mission Monitoring: Custom interactive SVG timelines for cumulative CSA radiation (mSv) showing safe autonomy runway in days, end-of-mission projections, and solar storm shielding rules; capillary blood glucose (mg/dL) against EHR corridors; and leukocyte trends (cells/uL) cross-checked against Low Defenses warnings.

- Bone & Muscle Density: Gravity-calibrated ARED, T2 treadmill, and CEVIS cycling routines with a live session timer, BMD retention charts vs. the -1.5%/month unexercised baseline, and automatic low-impact substitutions when prior joint surgeries exist.

- Mental Health & Confinement Psychology: Daily sleep/mood check-ins, Psychomotor Vigilance Testing (PVT, 5 stimuli) measuring reaction latency in milliseconds, a real Video Diary & Voice Log using cabin camera/mic with local lexical/vocal energy analysis, 4-4-4-4 guided anti-cortisol breathing, Cabin Circadian Light Controls (480nm Alert / 3500K Neutral / 1800K Amber), "Third-Quarter Phenomenon" phase tracking, and "My Earth Anchor" (offline family audio recordings + procedural Earth soundscapes).

- SOS Emergency Medical Console (/sos): Deterministic local clinical triage engine cross-referencing symptoms, live vitals, and EHR allergy contraindications across 6 space-adapted protocols (Seizure/Convulsion, Syncope/Fainting, Evetts-Russomano & Handstand Space CPR, Hypoxia/Air, Glucose/Thermal Shock, and Trauma/FAST Ultrasound Scan), complete with an episode stopwatch, Targeted Scan mini body map, and critical telemetry packet generation for asynchronous Earth Flight Surgeon review.

2. BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

• Survival Under Deep-Space Blackouts: When crews travel beyond Low Earth Orbit toward the Moon (Artemis) or Mars, communication delays reach up to 20 minutes one-way (40 minutes round-trip), making live Ground telemedicine unusable in acute crises. DeepTrau empowers non-physician crew to stabilize emergencies immediately.

• Personalized Prevention Instead of Generic Thresholds: Combining real-time telemetry with pre-flight surgical, immune, metabolic, and allergy records catches leukopenia trends, post-EVA hypoglycemia, and joint overload early while preventing dangerous drug contraindications during crises.

• Dual-Use Impact on Earth: Built without paid dependencies or cloud lock-in, the exact same guided self-assessment, manual hardware-free fallback, and offline SOS protocols can serve rural clinics without doctors, Antarctic bases, maritime crews, submarines, and disaster-response teams lacking connectivity.

3. TOOLS, CODING LANGUAGES, HARDWARE & SOFTWARE USED

• Core Codebase & Languages: TypeScript (^5.8.3), Next.js 15 (^15.3.2 App Router), React 19 (^19.1.0), Tailwind CSS (^4.1.7), lucide-react (^0.511.0), and open-source IBM Plex Sans / IBM Plex Mono fonts (SIL OFL 1.1).

• Native Browser APIs & Zero Paid Dependencies: 100% custom React <svg> charts and anatomical illustrations (zero third-party charting/UI kits), CSS transitions & Web Animations API (no Framer Motion), Web Audio API for procedural calming soundscapes and cabin alerts, navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia for real webcam/mic Video-Diary capture, FileReader for ultrasound imaging, and window.localStorage for offline state isolation.

• Hardware / Hosting / AI Tooling: Standard consumer laptop/desktop webcam & microphone (all 6 aerospace sensors are software-modeled for MVP portability); hosted on Netlify (https://deeptrau-spamedic.netlify.app/) via GitHub; developed with Visual Studio Code and Google Antigravity; official emblem/favicon drafted with OpenAI GPT under team art direction; offline "Earth Anchor" emotional voice/foley audio files generated with Google Gemini (Lyria / Lyria 3) from original team scripts.

4. CREATIVITY & KEY FACTORS CONSIDERED

• Creativity: Rather than treating disconnected devices as broken "N/A" states, DeepTrau turns hardware loss into a smart clinical adaptation—rewriting checklists into manual physical exams. Pairing quantitative mSv/BMD telemetry with human-centered circadian lighting and emotional Earth Anchor audio creates a holistic biomedical ecosystem, while a built-in Crisis & Scenario Simulator allows judges to trigger a full Solar Storm, Hypoglycemic Shock, or Microgravity Seizure in one click without corrupting other judges' sessions.

• Key Factors Considered: (1) Extreme Visual Ergonomics—a low-glare warm mineral light palette (#F7F5F0 / #FFFFFF / #2F5D46) designed to prevent eye fatigue during confinement, reserving Red (#B42318) and Amber (#B54708) strictly for medical alerts; (2) Non-Physician Clarity & Accessibility—multimodal inputs (mouse/click PVT, keyboard triage, camera/mic) plus live EN/ES language switching; (3) Open-Source Auditability & AI Honesty—strict zero-commercial-license policy and transparent documentation separating deterministic NASA/CSA rule engines from offline MVP AI-assisted features.
